pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft emotional piano intro, quiet late night atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
These days your phone stays silent
no messages, no light
when I call your number
your voice sounds far away

You say you're busy again
the same quiet answer
repeating through the line

It started with a small mistake
a word we didn't mean
I said sorry first
but something had already moved

[Chorus]
A day without you
feels longer than before
like a room without windows

If I had said one more word
if I had held you once
maybe the ending
would have waited a little longer

But you were already
walking away

[Verse 2]
I keep writing messages
you never read
words sitting alone on the screen

I never told you
how much it hurt
to watch the distance grow

And then one day
without a goodbye
your number disappeared

Like a door
closed without a sound

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective and fragile)

[Bridge]
Did you leave this quietly
so I wouldn't cry

Or was I already
a place you passed by

I stay here sometimes
listening to the silence
as if your steps
might return

[Chorus]
You left me standing
in the same small moment
where we once laughed

If I say I'm sorry again
would you turn around

I still wait here
with the same quiet words

I loved you
I still do

[Outro]
(soft fading piano outro)

The night grows slow

and your name
stays in the quiet air
